description.value: Fish on 5th is a family-owned fish and chips restaurant in Sidney, BC, operating for over 20 years and known locally as a favourite. The menu features fresh, locally sourced seafood alongside a dedicated vegan menu — an unusual combination that has earned it regional press coverage. The restaurant also offers catering and private event hosting.

address.value: 9812 Fifth Street, Sidney, British Columbia V8L 3E7, Canada

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 43m; rack (3 spaces) at 68m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business is active, with an online ordering app, operating hours, and contact details. The website corroborates the phone number but shows a different postal code (V8L 3E7) than OSM (V8L 2X4), which is flagged as a concern. The website explicitly mentions vegan options and an online ordering app (supporting takeout), but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM records V8L 2X4 but the business website shows V8L 3E7. Website value used in address field as it is the business's own source.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Sidney with an established web presence and over 20 years of operation. Useful to touring cyclists for a sit-down meal with takeout and vegan options.
